subject: Engineering walkthrough — aligning SE + customer engineers + procurement
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Satoshi Nakamura <satoshi@nexacorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Engineering walkthrough — aligning SE + customer engineers + procurement

Hi Satoshi —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call earlier this week. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a focused engineering walkthrough where our SE (Dev) can demonstrate a live request path, KV/prefix caching behavior, and a recommended inference config tuned for your batch job patterns.

Suggested 60-minute slots (PST times):
- Tue 2026-12-08 09:00–10:00
- Tue 2026-12-08 13:00–14:00
- Wed 2026-12-09 11:00–12:00

Attendees we recommend: your cloud/infra engineer, security lead (for brief Q&A around network egress & KMS), procurement (for timelines), our SE (Dev), and your account team (Marissa and me).

Can you confirm which of those works, or share 2–3 alternatives? If procurement needs a separate pre-call to discuss PO/contract cadence, we can include that too — when would that work for your team?

Appreciate it,
Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference
From: Satoshi Nakamura <satoshi@nexacorp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nexacorp.com, security.leads@nexacorp.com
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Engineering walkthrough — aligning SE + customer engineers + procurement

Evelyn, thanks — and thanks for the agenda.

Quick notes from our side:
- We have a mandatory board review week the week of Dec 7–11, so calendar is tight.
- Our infra eng (Takashi) is available on Wed afternoon (12/09) 13:30–15:00 PST only. Earlier on Tue is difficult.
- Security wants the demo to cover outbound IPs, KMS integration, and whether Redwood stores KV cache persistently.
- Procurement (cc'd) asks for an initial quote or indicative pricing and a copy of any standard SOW so they can validate timelines.

If you can do Wed 12/09 13:30 PST, that would be best. If not, offer two additional windows the week after.

Best,
Satoshi

On Fri, Dec 4, 2026 at 3:12 PM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Satoshi —
> ...
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Satoshi Nakamura <satoshi@nexacorp.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 18:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Engineering walkthrough — aligning SE + customer engineers + procurement

Thanks Satoshi — Dev here, SE on this account. Wed 12/09 13:30 PST works for me. I'll plan a 45–60 minute session:
- 15 mins: architecture & traffic flow (where KV cache lives, network egress, KMS)
- 20–30 mins: live walkthrough with a representative request pattern (batch + low-latency path)
- 10–15 mins: Q&A (security & infra)

Two quick ask-items so we can prep the environment:
1) Can your infra team confirm whether the demo should run against a sandbox in your VPC (private deployment) or if we can use Redwood-hosted demo dataset? If VPC, please share a short allowlist or contact for network setup.
2) Are there any constraints on sample PII/data in the demo? If so, we'll scrub examples.

I've attached a short SE demo runbook (SE-demo-runbook.pdf) that lists the artifacts I'll show. If procurement needs pricing, please see redwood-sla-summary.pdf attached — it's high-level; Marissa can follow up with an indicative quote.

If Wed 13:30 PST is confirmed, I'll send an invite (ICS) and a pre-read doc.

— Dev
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: procurement@nexacorp.com
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Satoshi Nakamura <satoshi@nexacorp.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Engineering walkthrough — aligning SE + customer engineers + procurement

Evelyn / Marissa —

Procurement here. Quick items from our side:
- Please provide an indicative price sheet or ballpark monthly cost and any minimum commitment options.
- We need the standard SOW and Master Services Agreement (MSA) to kick off legal review. If you have a redline-friendly PDF or DocuSign-friendly package, please attach.
- PO lead time for vendors is ~3 weeks once SOW is approved. If this is time-sensitive, include our category code in any quotes.

We can join the Wed 12/09 13:30 PST slot for a short handoff at the end if you want — otherwise we can have a 15-minute follow-up call next week to align on terms.

procurement@nexacorp.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Satoshi Nakamura <satoshi@nexacorp.com>, procurement@nexacorp.com, security.leads@nexacorp.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Engineering walkthrough — aligning SE + customer engineers + procurement

Thanks everyone — confirming Wed 2026-12-09 13:30–14:30 PST for the engineering walkthrough. Dev will lead the technical portion; Marissa will cover procurement questions and provide the indicative quote during the call.

Action items:
- Dev: attach the invite (Invite.ics) and pre-read (Drive link included) — please include the network allowlist section at top.
- Procurement: if you can share the category code, we will include it on the quote.
- Satoshi/Takashi: please confirm whether you prefer Redwood-hosted demo data or to provision a sandbox in your VPC.

I've attached the calendar invite (Invite.ics) and the pre-read (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB_example_runbook). Looking forward to it.

See you Wed —
Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
